summary:
Final acceptance PASSES at HEAD b8967c11773e1fa6a6c75e9318293835639918d5. The track suite exits 0 with 207 passed and 2 skipped. The pnpm audit shows critical 0 and high 15. All 15 high advisories sit in the register of open majors and no-fix packages. No advisory names next or follow-redirects. All eight acceptance criteria hold at HEAD.

The plan and the registry claim nothing beyond the evidence. The 16.4.6 patch is unmerged, unpushed and undeployed, and Daniel's word still gates the redeploy. Three caveats stay open as nonblocking findings. Doctor exits 1 for a cause that predates the track. The three project gates are unset. The Phase 0 to 3 acceptance results are absent from this machine.

ratings.evidence: Every spec AC holds at HEAD: the track suite exits 0 with 207 passed and pnpm audit shows critical 0 and high 15 inside the register; the open edges are the FR-2 and AC-2 text (16.4.1) and the declined prerelease hardening.
The guard rows prove failing-first behavior (red-p4-41-837755eaa.log:31 and red-p4-45-3aca2726f.log:45, then green), but two it.skipIf rows skip without local logs by PM decision.
The 74 track commits touch 41 paths, all manifests, lockfile, tests, docs and measure files, plus one recorded test fix (7ca3e7b7e, plan line 161); no Dockerfile, cloudbuild or workflow path changed.
Every claim in this result carries a command result or file:line, but the Phase 0 to 3 acceptance results and the Phase 2 logs are absent here and doctor plus the three project gates fall short.

reviewer_ratings.evidence: Its pass at 3aca2726f matches my lockfile diff: 13 keys removed and 11 added at HEAD, which equals its 12 and 10 plus the later follow-redirects move.
Its pass at 5450fa6c8 holds: pnpm-lock.yaml:10455 and :21763 key follow-redirects@1.16.2, and the live audit has no follow-redirects advisory.
Its NB-1 caught a real miss (GHSA-mrwp-f3q8-3g9p open at follow-redirects 1.16.1, fixed by task 4.5), but a high advisory open against AC-4 deserved a Blocker label.
Its NB-5 holds (measure/tracks.md:54 still reads 'Phase 1 ... next'), but its retry_recommendation escalate_human conflicts with its pass verdict.

Its pass and its NB-1 decline are sound because no vulnerable version passes the comparator, but I could not reproduce its 209-pass run: the p2 logs are absent and the suite gives 207 passed, 2 skipped.
